systems.system: online presence of central government and local authority entities (core departments and municipalities)
systems.tiers: most central government departments and municipalities; very limited e-services

systems.platform: no standardised system; electronic records stored locally and not consolidated
systems.tiers: civil registration centres: largely paper-based in rural areas, unevenly digitised in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire

systems.system: national backbone project (PCN, Projet de Couverture Nationale)
systems.platform: about 3,000 km of fibre backbone and 700 km of metropolitan optical loops in Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and Oyo
systems.owner: state-owned; managed by the ministry of planning, territorial equipment and major works, operated and commercialised by Congo Telecom
systems.tiers: links Pointe-Noire, Dolisie, Brazzaville, Oyo and Ouesso; no local government office said to be on it

systems.system: bulk purchase capacity contracts for unconnected MDAs (Congo Digital Acceleration Project, component 3)
systems.tiers: selected rural and remote schools, health centres and unconnected ministries, departments and agencies; proposed at concept stage

note: The concept document states that municipalities have an online presence and that small cities and villages lack last-mile connectivity, but says nothing of a connection at any local government's own office; the connectivity it proposes names ministries, departments and agencies, not local governments.
